props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the tooltip is initially open.

To render a controlled tooltip, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is currently open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the tooltip is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the tooltip is opened or closed.

props.name: disableHoverablePopup
props.description: Whether the tooltip contents can be hovered without closing the tooltip.

props.name: trackCursorAxis
props.description: Determines which axis the tooltip should track the cursor on.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: Unmounts the tooltip popup.
- `close`: Closes the tooltip imperatively when called.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tooltip is disabled.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the tooltip with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the tooltip's open state.
Can be created with the Tooltip.createHandle() method.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content of the tooltip.
This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: triggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the tooltip is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled tooltip.
There's no need to specify this prop when the tooltip is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the tooltip is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open tooltip.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a tooltip.

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the tooltip when it is opened.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before opening the tooltip. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close when this trigger is clicked.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long to wait before closing the tooltip. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
If `true`, the tooltip will not open when interacting with this trigger.
Note that this doesn't apply the `disabled` attribute to the trigger element.
If you want to disable the trigger element itself, you can pass the `disabled` prop to the trigger element via the `render` prop.

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: side
props.description:
Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description:
Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description:
Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.
